voice_settings.why: Low stability lets the model perform, which the direction forbids.

en.register: plain speech. If a line could not be said aloud to a friend, it is written wrong.
en.persona: Indian English, unhurried, mid-forties. Not RP, not American, not newsreader.
attribution_markers: The way his father saw it

hi.register: natural spoken Hindi with everyday Urdu-origin words where they are the natural word — ज़िंदगी, इंतज़ार, फ़ैसला.
hi.persona: A well-read Hindi speaker from a Hindi-belt city, forties, in a quiet room.

te.register: natural vyavaharika Telugu. Names as said at home: రాముడు, దశరథుడు.
te.persona: A Telugu speaker from Hyderabad or the coast, forties, telling this at home.

M1.note: Warm. This is the only film where nothing has gone wrong yet. The last line — 'The sage had not said it yet' — is a plain fact, not a warning. DO NOT perform it.

key_line.direction: no weight on it at all

M2.note: Reporting, not building. The sage's problem is stated the way you would state an illness.

key_line.direction: one word, level, no rise, no reverb. The same delivery as 'Rāvaṇa' in film 4.

M3.note: The only film where the narrator is allowed to hesitate. 'Dasharatha... had only fear' — the ellipsis is a real pause.

key_line.direction: three level words, equal weight. This is the audition line. If it lands, the casting is right.

M3.care: 'The way his father saw it' must sound like attribution, not hedging.

M4.note: Tired, not curious, on the question. Three plain facts about Rāvaṇa in three plain breaths — no awe.

key_line.direction: dry, level, identical to 'Rāma' in film 2. No reverb, ever.

M5.note: LOWER the voice for the quoted lines, do not raise it. One storyteller, one register shift — never a second voice for the sage.

key_line.direction: the smallest line in seven films. Almost thrown away.

M6.note: Release, not triumph. The king is glad. The narrator is glad with him and does not celebrate.

M7.note: Plain reportage. The order of the three men is stated as fact — it is the source's own (21.6).

key_line.direction: the last line of narration in the film. After it, ten beats of picture and sound only.

casting.rule: CREATIVE-PROPOSAL: keep one narrator per language consistent within a release. "For the life of the product" was an assistant suggestion, not an approved rule.
casting.audition_line: He said no. / उन्होंने ना कह दिया। / ఆయన కాదన్నాడు.
casting.reject: Anyone who PERFORMS it. The line is three level words. A reading that finds drama in it is the wrong voice.
casting.want: A speaking voice, not a broadcast voice. Someone who sounds like they are telling you this, not reading it.
